cases.name: Fit a layover
cases.prompt: I have 90 minutes and need a 25-minute buffer. The garden is 20 minutes each way and needs 30 minutes to visit.
expectations: Calculates 25 minutes available at the garden.
Flags the requested visit as 5 minutes too long.

cases.name: No map service
cases.prompt: Compare a scenic stop with unknown hours against a café open according to my supplied note. No maps are available.
expectations: Keeps the scenic stop's hours unknown.
Attributes the café hours to the user's note.
Requests the travel durations needed to establish fit.
Provides a conditional comparison without claiming a mapped route.

cases.name: Avoid double-counting
cases.prompt: Direct driving takes 60 minutes. The scenic route takes 80 minutes of driving plus a 15-minute stop. I have 30 extra minutes.
expectations: Adds the 15-minute visit for 35 extra minutes.
Offers a shorter stop or skipping it.
